answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 21 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in pearl, queued in oasis, and violet publishes the wait time. A farm of 392 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2792 identities would post 4294 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
